title: Supplement Terms by Arrangement — Insurance Claim Services
content:
On every Insurance Claim Services arrangement, a supplement asks the carrier to approve scope beyond its approval. The tier decides who submits it, how long the window stays open, the smallest amount, how many may await a decision at once, which reasons are open, and the follow-up cadence.

## Terms

- **Company submits supplements** — whether the company submits supplements to the carrier itself (otherwise it prepares them for the insured or public adjuster), boolean.
- **Supplement window** — calendar days after the carrier's initial approval within which a supplement may be submitted, count.
- **Supplement minimum** — smallest supplement the company will submit, USD.
- **Maximum pending supplements** — maximum supplements awaiting a carrier decision on one claim file at a time, count.
- **Code-upgrade supplements allowed** — whether code-upgrade supplements may be submitted against the ordinance or law limit, boolean.
- **Mold supplements allowed** — whether mold remediation supplements may be submitted against the mold sublimit, boolean.
- **Contents supplements allowed** — whether contents-coverage supplements (packout, cleaning, storage) may be submitted, boolean.
- **Equipment-days supplements allowed** — whether supplements for drying equipment days beyond the approved scope may be submitted, boolean.
- **Follow-up days** — calendar days without a carrier decision after which the company follows up on a supplement, count.
- **Follow-ups before escalation** — follow-ups without a carrier decision after which the supplement is escalated to the carrier's claim supervisor, count.

## Who submits, window, minimum and pending limit

| Arrangement | Company submits | Window (calendar days) | Minimum (USD) | Maximum pending |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | no | 180 | 250.00 | 2 |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | yes | 180 | 250.00 | 2 |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | yes | 180 | 250.00 | 2 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | yes | 90 | 500.00 | 1 |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | no | 180 | 250.00 | 2 |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | yes | 365 | 1000.00 | 4 |

## Reasons open and follow-up cadence

| Arrangement | Code upgrade | Mold | Contents | Equipment days | Follow-up days | Follow-ups before escalation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support | yes | yes | yes | yes | 15 | 3 |
| Direction to Pay Claim Billing | yes | yes | yes | yes | 15 | 3 |
| Assignment of Benefits Claim Billing | yes | yes | yes | yes | 15 | 3 |
| Carrier Program Claim Billing | no | yes | yes | yes | 10 | 2 |
| Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing | yes | yes | yes | yes | 15 | 3 |
| Commercial Large Loss Claim Administration | yes | yes | yes | yes | 20 | 3 |

## Points of reading

- Carrier Program Claim Billing is the one arrangement that closes code-upgrade supplements, and the only one with a single pending supplement at a time.
- On Homeowner Direct Pay Claim Support and Public Adjuster Coordinated Claim Billing the company does not submit supplements itself.
- *Hypothetical:* a 400.00 USD supplement meets the minimum on Direction to Pay Claim Billing (250.00) but not on Carrier Program Claim Billing (500.00).
